gold: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)

selector.rationale: Multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells with increased mitotic activity, positive for CD68, and negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme, which is most consistent with Giant Cell Tumor

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman Disease
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and clinical presentation not typical for Rosai-Dorfman Disease

rejected.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma
rejected.why: Patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma is noted, but current presentation and histopathology do not support recurrence of Hodgkin lymphoma

rejected.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
rejected.why: Although some features are consistent, the presence of multinodular proliferation and specific immunohistochemical profile points more towards Giant Cell Tumor
